purpose: Local educational before/after copy comparison for a returning document user

before.label: Before · Authored example
before.title: Welcome back!
before.body:
Explore amazing possibilities and begin a productive journey today.
Choose a document below.

comparison.meaning: Both panels use the same ready state, two document records, modification times, and action. Before contains generic welcome/instruction copy; After is a proposed authored correction. The comparison is educational, not a measured user test.

primary_action.label: Find a document
primary_action.effect: Record the intention to open the document finder; no real navigation, saving, publishing, or transmission

reset_action.label: Reset demo state
reset_action.effect: Clear local demo action state and close the shared-facts disclosure; retain the original documents and ready state

evidence_disclosure.label: State and facts shared by both panels
evidence_disclosure.content: The ready state, returning flag, and the two identical document records
